title: Find Palindrome With Fixed Length
summary: Given an integer array queries and a positive integer intLength, generate an array answer where each element is either the queries[i]-th smallest positive palindrome of length intLength or -1 if no such palindrome exists.
statement: Given an integer array queries and a positive integer intLength, generate an array answer where each element is either the queries[i]-th smallest positive palindrome of length intLength or -1 if no such palindrome exists. A palindrome reads identically forward and backward, and cannot start with zero.
constraints: For each 1-indexed query, return that smallest positive palindrome with exactly int_length digits.
No palindrome may have a leading zero.
Return -1 when the requested rank exceeds all palindromes of that length.
reference_solution:
def fixed_length_kth_palindromes(queries,int_length):
    half_length=(int_length+1)//2;start=10**(half_length-1);end=10**half_length;answer=[]
    for query in queries:
        half=start+query-1
        if half>=end:answer.append(-1);continue
        text=str(half);answer.append(int(text+text[-2::-1] if int_length%2 else text+text[::-1]))
    return answer

hints: A palindrome is determined entirely by its leading half, including the middle digit for odd lengths.
The valid half prefixes are consecutive integers starting at the smallest nonzero half.
Add query-1 to the starting half; reject past the half-length limit; mirror all or all but the middle digit.
Numeric order of fixed-length palindromes matches numeric order of their leading halves, giving a direct rank mapping.
